title: SB1055 (2024 Regular): RELATING TO ELECTIONS.

other_topics: voting-rights: SECTION 1 (HRS 19-3(4)(B)) — makes photographing a voter's face without permission of the voter and an election official, near a voting site, a form of election intimidation
